parts.name: Pot Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pot, made of ceramic material with a ribbed cylindrical shape. It serves as the structural container of the object.
parts.Functional_description: The pot body holds and supports the contents placed inside, providing stability and containment.
parts.Movement_description: The pot body is a static part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Stuffs Contained In The Pot
parts.Basic_description: This part represents the contents inside the pot, typically soil or similar material used for planting or storage.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the medium for holding plants or other items within the pot, providing support and nutrients if used for planting.
parts.Movement_description: The contents can be removed, replaced, or shifted within the pot depending on use.
